Translate business needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and manageable delivery plans. Follow HIPAA-aligned security, privacy, and healthcare data-handling requirements. Required Qualifications 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and supporting production applications. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud — deployment, identity, networking, managed data services, monitoring, and cost optimization. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with HIPAA-aligned software development and secure healthcare integrations. Compensation Up to $4,000 USD per month, based on experience and qualifications.
